# PLaMo 3 tiny reference fixture

Built with PLaMo.

This is a deterministic, randomly initialized test model generated by `scripts/pin_plamo3_tiny.py` from PFN's PLaMo 3 model code at revision cc8e88169807d5a272e8ff06db12eb0129b67f81. It contains no trained parameters from the released checkpoint and is not a translation model for practical use.

This fixture and the associated PLaMo reference goldens are provided under the [PLaMo Community License Agreement](../plamo3-LICENSE.txt), separately from GoInfer's MIT-licensed runtime code. Recipients must comply with that agreement, including its redistribution and commercial-use conditions.
